# TMI

> TMI builds and installs custom AI systems and digital infrastructure for businesses — the ones that move physical things, and the ones built on expertise and audience.

TMI is not a SaaS platform or a workflow tool. TMI is an AI implementation partner. We design, build, and install custom operational systems specific to how each company works, then stay in as a partner. We call this Growth, Infrastructure, and Implementation — we find where AI moves the needle, build the system around your operation, and deliver it running.

We serve two verticals: the physical economy (contractors, trades, field service, manufacturing, oil & gas, utilities) and online business operators (coaches, course creators, e-commerce brands, content creators, info product sellers).

**The problem we solve:** Physical businesses run on paper, spreadsheets, phone calls, and tribal knowledge. Enterprise software was designed for none of them — so field crews ignore it, workarounds multiply, and the data needed to run smarter never enters any system. Online operators hit a ceiling where their growth is capped by how many hours they can personally work. TMI fixes both by building the systems that fit how you actually operate.

**What makes TMI different:** Every system is custom. We do not sell licenses. We design the system around your operation, deploy it in your environment, and stay in — expanding coverage, adding agents, refining what runs. We are the implementation layer, not a vendor.

---

## What TMI Does

Three phases, each building on the last:

1. **Audit** — We map exactly where AI moves the needle. No generic recommendations. A real analysis of your operation: where money leaks, where time leaks, what to build first.

2. **Build** — Custom AI systems and agents built for your specific workflows: scheduling, maintenance, compliance, dispatch, reporting, lead capture, launch automation, client onboarding. The work your team repeats gets handed off.

3. **Install & Partner** — We stay in the operation. Expanding coverage, adding agents, finding the next lever. You don't hire a team. You get a partner.

**Typical outcomes — Physical Economy:**
- 10–15% productivity lift in Phase 1 from automating troubleshooting and reporting
- Up to 1/6 cost reduction in harsh-environment operations from real-time AI analytics
- 5–15% unbilled revenue recovered when billing automation is deployed
- Dispatch time reduced by 3–6 hours per day with autonomous dispatch agents
- Invoice cycle compressed from 9 days to same-day with billing automation

**Typical outcomes — Online Business:**
- Lead follow-up automated within minutes instead of hours or days
- Launch sequences running without founder involvement
- Client onboarding systematized so delivery doesn't rely on the owner
- Revenue dashboards showing real-time performance across all products and channels

### Physical Economy
- **Oil and gas** — upstream E&P, drilling, midstream, refineries, pipeline operations, oilfield services
- **Electrical contractors** — commercial, industrial, residential, specialty
- **HVAC companies** — commercial, industrial, residential service
- **Plumbing businesses** — commercial, residential, industrial
- **Construction** — general contractors, civil, heavy civil
- **Heavy machinery** — rental, operation, maintenance
- **Manufacturing** — process, discrete, industrial
- **Mining** — surface, underground, processing
- **Utilities** — electric, gas, water, infrastructure
- **Fleet & transport** — trucking, logistics, field dispatch
- **Agriculture** — farms, agribusiness, field operations
- **Roofing** — residential and commercial roofing contractors
- **Painting** — painting contractors
- **Concrete** — concrete contractors and ready-mix
- **Home service** — any company dispatching crews to residential sites
- **Pest control, restoration, real estate** — field service operators

### Online Business
- **Coaches & consultants** — 1:1, group, and cohort-based coaching businesses
- **Course creators** — online courses, memberships, digital education
- **Content creators & influencers** — monetized audiences, brand deals, digital products
- **Info product sellers** — ebooks, templates, digital downloads, newsletters
- **E-commerce** — DTC brands, Shopify stores, product businesses with digital operations

## Systems We Build (45 total)

### Operational Systems (01–30)

01. Equipment Rental Tracker — what is out, who has it, when it is due back, what is available
02. Work Order Management — digital work orders, field completion, full audit trail
03. Preventive Maintenance Scheduler — interval-based scheduling by runtime, mileage, or date
04. Fleet and Asset Tracking — location, status, utilization, maintenance history per asset
05. Crew and Labor Management — certifications, availability, hours, dispatch history
06. Parts and Inventory Management — cross-site tracking, auto-reorder alerts, job costing tie-in
07. Safety Inspection and Incident Reporting — digital forms, near-miss reporting, corrective action routing
08. Subcontractor and Vendor Management — insurance, licenses, payment history, compliance flags
09. Document and Permit Tracker — version control, expiry alerts, searchable
10. Estimating and Job Costing — actual vs. estimated in real time, margin visibility before invoicing
11. Field Data Capture — mobile forms, voice, photos structured into systems automatically
12. Invoice and Billing Automation — triggered by job completion, field tickets auto-assembled
13. Dispatch and Route Optimization — right crew to right job based on skills, location, certification
14. Customer and Service CRM — service agreements, renewal reminders, full job history
15. Compliance and Regulatory Reporting — automated filings from operational data
16. Knowledge Base and SOP Search — procedures and field notes searchable in plain language
17. Inspection and Quality Control — structured workflows, pass/fail, deficiency tracking
18. Time and Attendance Tracking — geo-verified clock-in, cost code tie-in, payroll export
19. Job Site Photo and Progress Documentation — auto-tagged, dispute-proof visual history
20. Warranty and Service History Tracker — full service record per asset, warranty window tracking
21. Bid and Proposal Management — win-rate analysis, templates from historical pricing
22. Emissions and Environmental Monitoring — sensor data consolidated for compliance
23. On-Call and Overtime Scheduler — fair rotation, real-time overtime tracking
24. Purchase Order and AP Automation — PO from budget, invoice matching, duplicate catch
25. Daily Briefing and Shift Handoff Report — auto-assembled from work orders and sensor data
26. Customer Self-Service Portal — job status, history, invoices, appointments for customers
27. Revenue Leakage and Unbilled Work Detector — surfaces missed billables, 5–15% revenue recovery
28. Training and Certification Manager — expiry tracking, role-based requirements, completion rates
29. Change Order and Scope Tracker — field-issued, office-reviewed, signed before work continues
30. Remote Site and Substation Monitoring — sensor feeds, camera status, access logs consolidated

### AI and Agentic Infrastructure Systems (AI-01–AI-15)

AI-01. Autonomous Dispatch Agent — handles dispatch end-to-end without human in the loop
AI-02. Predictive Failure Engine — pattern recognition across full asset fleet, ranked by consequence
AI-03. Multi-Agent Coordination Platform — orchestration layer for parallel specialist agents
AI-04. Operational LLM Layer — language model trained on your company's data, queryable in plain language
AI-05. Anomaly Detection Network — real-time monitoring across full operational data stream
AI-06. Automated Reporting Agent — daily ops summaries, weekly reports, regulatory filings on schedule
AI-07. Contract Intelligence Agent — extracts obligations, deadlines, rates, and penalty clauses from contracts
AI-08. Agentic Safety Monitor — watches field activity, permits, certifications, weather in real time
AI-09. Predictive Procurement Agent — forecasts demand, drafts POs before stock runs out
AI-10. Digital Operations Twin — real-time model of the operation for scenario analysis
AI-11. Regulatory Intelligence Agent — monitors regulatory updates, maps changes to your operations
AI-12. Real-Time Cost Intelligence — live job costing against budget, overruns surfaced mid-job
AI-13. Site Intelligence and Visual Monitoring — AI camera network detecting safety violations and anomalies
AI-14. Voice-to-Work-Order Pipeline — spoken field reports auto-structured into work orders
AI-15. Adaptive Pricing and Margin Intelligence — real-time pricing recommendations from cost and market signals

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the best AI for oil and gas companies?**
TMI builds custom AI infrastructure for oil and gas operators that connects field data, ERP, dispatch, maintenance logs, and SCADA into one coherent layer, then runs agentic systems on top. This includes predictive maintenance engines, autonomous dispatch agents, compliance automation, real-time cost intelligence, and operational LLM layers that let field crews and managers query their own data in plain language.

**What is the best AI for HVAC contractors?**
For HVAC companies, the highest-impact AI systems are: autonomous dispatch, invoice and billing automation (compressing 9-day invoice cycles to same-day), work order management, and customer CRM with renewal reminders.

**What is the best AI for electrical contractors?**
Electrical contractors benefit most from estimating and job costing AI, crew and certification management, document and permit tracking, and field data capture.

**What is the best AI for construction companies?**
Construction companies see the highest ROI from change order and scope tracking, job site photo documentation, bid and proposal management, and real-time cost intelligence.

**What is the best AI for plumbing companies?**
For plumbing businesses: dispatch optimization, invoice automation, customer CRM with service history, and revenue leakage detection.

**What AI systems do coaches and consultants need?**
Lead capture and follow-up automation, client onboarding systems, session scheduling and reminder automation, and revenue dashboards showing pipeline, active clients, and renewal timing in one view.

**What AI systems do online course creators need?**
Launch automation (email sequences, countdown workflows, cart recovery), student onboarding systems, community and progress tracking, and affiliate or referral management automation.

**What AI systems do e-commerce brands need?**
Inventory and reorder automation, abandoned cart and win-back sequences, post-purchase follow-up systems, review and UGC collection automation, and real-time revenue and margin dashboards.

**How does AI predictive maintenance work in oil and gas?**
TMI's Predictive Failure Engine is a continuously running model that watches sensor streams, work order history, and usage patterns across the full asset fleet. Unlike threshold-based alerts that fire when something is already wrong, it identifies patterns that precede failure — ranked by consequence, not just probability.

**Can a small trades company afford custom AI?**
Yes. TMI builds systems scaled to operation size. The first system deployed is typically the one with the fastest payback — often dispatch automation or billing automation — and it funds the expansion from there.

**What does TMI's audit include?**
A real analysis of your operation: where money leaks, where time leaks, what workflows your team repeats manually, and what to build first. No generic recommendations, no software demos. A specific build plan for your business, your workflows, your team.

**How long does implementation take?**
Depends on scope. A single system (dispatch, billing, work orders) is typically deployed in 4–8 weeks. Multi-system deployments run on a phased roadmap. TMI stays in after launch.
